SEC. 12410. SUNSET.

    Section 713 of the National Oilheat Research Alliance Act of 2000 
(42 U.S.C. 6201 note; Public Law 106-469) is amended by striking ``9 
years'' and inserting ``18 years''.

    Approved February 7, 2014.
